title: Increase waist lift and let the upper body dangle naturally
objective: Make the held pose visibly stronger and cuter: raise the waist farther while shoulders/head and relaxed arms fall below the waist support, keeping the existing dangling legs and smooth release. Deliver locally without pushing.
architecture: Codex directly implements on the current isolated checkout from clean 37197bb641cdfa577e7c3bf76ab9e487a22e2235. No Claude, delegation, remote publication or live model calls.

Adjust only the procedural pose animator: increase the waist lift, fold the upper torso through its own waist/chest bones and allow the head to droop. The pelvis remains the support point rather than rotating the whole figure as a rigid image. Relax hand IK as well as foot IK during the held pose, then orient the existing arms downward relative to world gravity with bounded shortest-angle blending.

Use a slightly longer eased modifier transition for entering/leaving a held pose so the larger fold unfolds naturally on release. Keep the existing landing clip duration, native timeline mixes, input handling, camera, actor scale, assets, roaming/sleep and voice/cache behavior.

Verify raised waist, lowered head/shoulders, hands below shoulders, suspended feet, relaxed/restored IK, no modifier accumulation and uninterrupted recovery. Existing frame tests exercise the full pose/motion range for visibility and unclipped borders; native pointer captures are visually reviewed. Re-run offline pointer/roaming/chat/window and Java/build checks.

Install only allowlisted reviewed public files into the known daily runtime using frozen baseline/hash backups and private/fixed-voice metadata guards. Verify actual-runtime checks and compiled parity, then normally restart only the identified app through its unchanged free entry. Restart clears temporary chat; no push or API verification.
non_goals: No private configuration, model/TTS call, voice/cache, asset, renderer/camera/scale, input or launcher changes.
No cursor snapping, gravity simulation, new animations or dependency updates.

acceptance_criteria.requirement: The held waist is visibly higher and the upper body/head relax below the waist support, with freely hanging arms and feet rather than an upright rigid torso.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Bone position/orientation and IK tests plus own native held-pose image inspection.

acceptance_criteria.requirement: The larger pose enters/exits smoothly, restores IK/standing or conversation pose and remains visible/unclipped without accumulating transforms.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Existing and updated animator/interruption/live-frame tests, native pickup/landing/dialog and roaming/chat regressions.

acceptance_criteria.requirement: The reviewed local daily runtime uses the new pose while private settings, fixed audio, launchers and unrelated code are preserved; no push/model calls.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Frozen scoped install, actual-runtime checks/class parity and safe startup markers with technical evidence and pending user visual acceptance.

risks: The amount of folding and cuteness are subjective; inspect the native preview and keep user visual acceptance distinct from technical checks.
Hand IK must restore after dragging so original authored poses remain intact. Keep all changes weighted and reset each frame.
rollback: Stop the identified app, restore only guarded public-file backups if installed hashes match, rebuild and start the unchanged daily entry. Preserve private files, fixed voice cache and unrelated sources.
